description: Simulate a transaction before signing it: what leaves and enters the wallet (native, ERC-20, NFTs, SPL) with USD values, approvals granted (unlimited / to non-contracts), revert reason, gas and fee, plus a risk level. EVM chains via eth_simulateV1 (raw call: from, to, data, value); Solana via simulateTransaction (base64 transaction, unsigned is fine). Nothing is broadcast. Paid ($0.0015, x402).

transaction.description: Solana: base64-encoded transaction (legacy or v0; signatures not required)

value.description: EVM: value in wei (decimal or 0x hex)
